reviewer: Claude Code (Opus 5.5) with a fresh-context medium reviewer subagent

claims.summary: Pin rank transfer: (a) in the charged character pseudoideal J_D of (G,c), for an edge set F and pin assignment rho as in lem:weighted-restriction-transport (G'=G-F with supplied expansion, adjusted charge, nonzero total charge, max(4,2g')<=D'<=D, D'<eps'n/8) and a tuple of degree <= e_max with e_max+K<=D', the tuple's rank on V_K is at least the pinned tuple's rank on G''s degree-K space in J'_(D'), by kernel inclusion. (b) For every edge set T, the conjunction count q_T(K) of thm:conjunction-quotient-rank, the number of cosets of the cut space plus F_3^T met by the support-K ball, equals h_(G-T)(K), the number of cut-code classes of G-T met by its support-K ball, since projecting off T sends the cut space of G onto that of G-T; this is the puncturing in thm:punctured-quotient-contraction's proof, stated as a residual graph.
claims.assessment: Working elementary proof: (a) from lem:weighted-restriction-transport's inclusion (nonzero total charge assumed with it), (b) from the projection of the cut space, implicit in the puncturing of thm:punctured-quotient-contraction. Passed by the sole fresh-context medium reviewer with corrections.
claims.rationale: Translates the restriction cleanup of the sparse-extension lead into the charged ratio setting and identifies the conjunction count with a residual cut-class count.
claims.next_action: Use with an upper bound at level K-d in the pinned space, which the transfer alone does not supply.

claims.summary: Pin transfer cost: for a pin of tau edges F as in lem:pin-rank-transfer (a), any short-range ratio bound obtained from c(K-d)<=h(K-d) and (a), i.e. c(K-d)/c(K)<=h(K-d)/c'(K), is at least h(K-d)/h(K) times h(K)/h_(G-F)(K) >= lambda^(-a(F)), lambda=(K+2m)/(3K+2m), a(F)=tau-dim B_F >= (1-1/eps)tau when eps>1 and tau<=D, by lem:pin-rank-transfer (b) and thm:punctured-quotient-contraction. On the power-growing charged family the factor over canonical is at least e^(c tau) for tau<=D, superpolynomial whenever tau/Delta -> infinity, while cor:star-closure-ratio proves at most e^(9.5 tau d/(n Delta)) for components with a low-incidence closure inside the window. A limit of that bookkeeping, not of the components.
claims.assessment: Working consequence of thm:punctured-quotient-contraction read through lem:pin-rank-transfer (b) as a limit of the pin bookkeeping; lem:off-support-occupancy met the matching factor for functions of bounded-incidence sets. Passed by the sole fresh-context medium reviewer with corrections.
claims.rationale: Shows restriction cleanup, pinning the edges a component reads, cannot bring wide components to a canonical ratio at polynomial cost in the charged window.
claims.next_action: Find an upper bound at level K-d in a pinned space for components of the open class.
